name: Church Culture
tagline: Hilarious moments and traditions from the pews to the pulpit.
description: Laugh together about the traditions, songs, and Sunday moments we all love, then see how God works through them. Warm, funny, and always respectful.

cards.title: Dwelling Together
cards.prompt: Share your favorite thing about being with your church family.
cards.body: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

cards.title: Don't Skip Church
cards.prompt: Give one reason showing up together matters, in 10 seconds.
cards.body: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

cards.title: Joyful Noise
cards.prompt: Hum or tap the beat of a favorite worship song and say why it matters to you.
cards.body: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands. Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

cards.prompt: What's the funniest (and respectful!) thing you've seen happen at a church service?
What's your favorite part of Sunday: the music, the food, the people, or the Sunday best outfits?
Which church tradition do you love most, and what does it teach you about God?

cards.title: Praise Break
cards.prompt: Lead the group in a 20-second praise moment: clap, sing, or say 'Hallelujah' your favorite way.

cards.title: Choir Director
cards.prompt: Pick a worship song and lead the group in the first line. Everyone joins in.

cards.title: Name That Tune
cards.prompt: One person hums a worship song while their team guesses the title.
cards.instruction: No words allowed. Most correct songs wins.

cards.title: Sermon in 30 Seconds
cards.prompt: Each team gets a verse and delivers a funny, respectful 30-second mini-sermon with one clear lesson.
cards.instruction: The group votes on the best sermon.

cards.prompt: Share a church memory that made you laugh and also helped your faith.
Share a time your church family showed up for you.
